evidence.observation: Growth-entry temperature briefly overshot the 750 °C setpoint to 760.6 °C, then settled.
Temperature is stable at 750.2 °C against a 750 °C setpoint; heater power is 45.2%, consistent with the recent settled hold.
Argon flow is 100.1 sccm against a 100 sccm setpoint; controller reports running.
Pressure and exhaust oxygen sensors are not installed; their null readings are not sensor faults.
